```{r}
G1000 <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/igsr-1000 genomes phase 3 release.tsv.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

pop <- c("KHV","BEB","YRI","PJL","GWD","MSL","ESN","LWK","CHS")
#- Kinh in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
#- Bengali in Bangladesh
#- Han Chinese South
#- Luhya in Webuye, Kenya
#- Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria
#- Punjabi in Lahore, Pakistan
#- Gambian in Western Division, The Gambia - Mandinka
#- Mende in Sierra Leone
#- Esan in Nigeria

pops <- subset(G1000, G1000$Population.code %in% pop)

all(grepl("1000 Genomes phase 3 release",pops$Data.collections))

pops[,c(4,1,5,2)]

#Just for plink 
write.table(file=resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/1000G_keep.txt"), pops[,c(1,1)] , sep="\t",row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

write.table(file=resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/1000G_keep_all.txt"), pops[,c(4,1,5,2)] , sep="\t",row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)



```
